items.title: Why cyclical stocks are poised for a comeback
items.summary: Longview Economics global economist and chief market strategist Chris Watling joins Market Domination to discuss what he calls a "beautiful consolidation," what he's observed in the markets over the summer, and why he believes cyclical stocks are poised for a comeback.

items.title: What Could Push NVDA Stock Higher From Here?
